children: This summary is based on reports from exporters for the period September 4-10, 2026.

Wheat: Net sales of 325,900 metric tons (MT) for 2026/2027 were up 68 percent from the previous week, but unchanged from the prior 4-week average. Increases primarily for the Philippines (189,600 MT), Mexico (70,300 MT, including decreases of 100 MT), South Korea (51,500 MT), Vietnam (32,800 MT, including 30,000 MT switched from unknown destinations), and Colombia (13,000 MT), were offset by reductions for unknown destinations (52,800 MT) and Japan (29,600 MT). Exports of 502,000 MT were up 2 percent from the previous week and 5 percent from the prior 4-week average. The destinations were primarily to Mexico (139,000 MT), Japan (118,100 MT), Thailand (95,300 MT), the Philippines (82,600 MT), and Vietnam (33,900 MT).

Corn: Net sales of 1,026,700 MT for 2026/2027 primarily for Mexico (626,000 MT, including 33,000 MT switched from unknown destinations and decreases of 2,500 MT), Japan (150,200 MT, including 85,000 MT switched from unknown destinations and decreases of 2,400 MT), Colombia (117,700 MT), South Korea (83,900 MT, including 65,000 MT switched from unknown destinations and decreases of 600 MT), and Saudi Arabia (63,700 MT, including 60,000 MT switched from unknown destinations), were offset by reductions for unknown destinations (316,200 MT) and Canada (100 MT). Exports of 1,683,200 were primarily to Mexico (436,600 MT), South Korea (338,200 MT), Japan (248,400 MT), Colombia (134,700 MT), and Spain (110,300 MT).
Barley: No net sales for 2026/2027 were reported for the week. Exports of 1,300 MT were to Canada (1,000 MT), Japan (200 MT), and South Korea (100 MT).

Sorghum: Net sales of 4,100 MT for the 2026/2027 primarily for Mexico (5,800 MT) and Japan (300 MT), were offset by reductions for China (2,000 MT). Exports of 10,300 MT were to Mexico (5,800 MT), China (4,400 MT), and Japan (100 MT).

Rice: Net sales of 36,500 MT for 2026/2027 were down 29 percent from the previous week and 13 percent from the prior 4-week average. Increases primarily for unknown destinations (12,000 MT), Haiti (7,200 MT), Mexico (6,300 MT), Guatemala (5,500 MT switched from unknown destinations), and Canada (3,600 MT), were offset by reductions for Honduras (700 MT). Exports of 40,200 MT were up noticeably from the previous week, but down 5 percent from the prior 4-week average. The destinations were primary to Haiti (15,200 MT), South Korea (7,600 MT), Guatemala (5,500 MT), Honduras (4,300 MT), and Mexico (3,900 MT).

Soybeans: Net sales of 1,702,000 MT for 2026/2027 were primarily for China (875,300 MT, including decreases of 3,800 MT), unknown destinations (218,900 MT), Mexico (138,600 MT), Indonesia (111,400 MT, including 58,000 MT switched from unknown destinations and decreases of 100 MT), and Algeria (80,000 MT). Exports of 622,700 MT were primarily to China (328,300 MT), Indonesia (89,600 MT), Egypt (57,400 MT), Bangladesh (57,300 MT), and Taiwan (20,300 MT).
Exports for Own Account: For 2026/2027, exports for own account totaling 1,800 MT, all Taiwan.

Soybean Cake and Meal: Net sales of 23,700 MT for 2025/2026--a marketing-year low--were down 44 percent from the previous week and 65 percent from the prior 4-week average. Increases primarily for the Netherlands (19,500 MT, including 20,000 MT switched from unknown destinations and decreases of 500 MT), Guatemala (18,300 MT, including 18,000 MT switched from unknown destinations), the Philippines (13,200 MT), Taiwan (7,000 MT), and Malaysia (3,000 MT), were offset by reductions primarily for unknown destinations (38,000 MT), Canada (3,800 MT), Mexico (3,400 MT), Japan (1,400 MT), and Belgium (700 MT). Net sales of 186,800 MT for 2026/2027 primarily for unknown destinations (99,000 MT), Colombia (37,300 MT), Vietnam (16,100 MT), Burma (15,300 MT), and Mexico (12,300 MT), were offset by reductions for Morocco (2,000 MT) and Honduras (1,100 MT). Exports of 308,100 MT were up 24 percent from the previous week and 25 percent from the prior 4-week average. The destinations were primarily to the Philippines (96,900 MT), Mexico (46,200 MT), the Dominican Republic (31,400 MT), Saudi Arabia (30,100 MT), and the Netherlands (19,600 MT).
Optional Origin Sales: For 2025/2026, the current outstanding balance of 2,000 MT, all Ecuador. For 2026/2027, the current outstanding balance of 3,500 MT, all Ecuador.

Soybean Oil: Net sales reductions of 200 MT were reported for 2025/2026. Net sales primarily for Mexico (900 MT, including decreases of 100 MT), were offset by reductions for Canada (1,100 MT). Total net sales of 4,500 MT for 2026/2027 were for Canada. Exports of 2,200 MT were up noticeably from the previous week and 52 percent from the prior 4-week average. The destinations were primarily to Canada (1,300 MT) and Mexico (800 MT).

Cotton: Net sales of Upland totaling 71,200 RB for 2026/2027 were down 4 percent from the previous week and 30 percent from the prior 4-week average. Increases were primarily for Vietnam (28,200 RB, including 600 RB switched from Indonesia and decreases of 1,800 RB), Guatemala (14,000 RB), Pakistan (7,500 RB), Honduras (6,500 RB, including 200 RB switched from Guatemala and decreases of 700 RB), and Thailand (4,400 RB). Net sales of 6,200 RB for 2027/2028 were primarily for Guatemala (5,600 RB). Exports of 142,100 RB were down 20 percent from the previous week and 26 percent from the prior 4-week average. The destinations were primarily to Vietnam (44,600 RB), Pakistan (24,700 RB), India (18,000 RB), Bangladesh (16,200 RB), and Mexico (9,900 RB). Net sales of Pima totaling 8,300 RB for 2026/2027 were down 17 percent from the previous week, but up 68 percent from the prior 4-week average. Increases reported for India (3,400 RB), Bangladesh (2,200 RB), Thailand (1,700 RB, including 200 RB switched from Italy), Peru (700 RB), and Pakistan (500 RB), were offset by reductions for Italy (200 RB). Exports of 4,100 RB were down 22 percent from the previous week and 36 percent from the prior 4-week average. The destinations were to India (2,900 RB), Peru (500 RB), Turkey (400 RB), Thailand (200 RB), and Colombia (100 RB).

Exports for Own Account: For 2026/2027, new exports for own account totaling 4,500 RB were to India (4,100 RB) and Vietnam (400 RB). The current exports for own account outstanding balance of 81,100 RB were to India (54,700 RB), Vietnam (25,900 RB), and Turkey (500 RB).

Hides and Skins: Net sales of 204,500 pieces for 2026 were up 43 percent from the previous week, but down 18 percent from the prior 4-week average. Increases primarily for China (140,200 whole cattle hides, including decreases of 64,300 pieces), South Korea (31,100 whole cattle hides, including decreases of 1,600 pieces), Mexico (25,700 whole cattle hides, including decreases of 3,300 pieces), Turkey (2,500 whole cattle hides), and Thailand (2,400 whole cattle hides, including decreases of 5,400 pieces), were offset by reductions for India (200 pieces). Exports of 262,200 whole cattle hides were up 38 percent from the previous week and 6 percent from the prior 4-week average. The destinations were primarily to China (153,800 pieces), Mexico (40,500 pieces), South Korea (21,100 pieces), Thailand (17,600 pieces), and Italy (9,500 pieces).

Net sales of 81,400 wet blues for 2026 were down 20 percent from the previous week and 28 percent from the prior 4-week average. Increases were reported for Thailand (29,000 unsplit), Bangladesh (28,800 unsplit), Vietnam (21,600 unsplit), China (1,200 unsplit), and Italy (800 unsplit, including decreases of 100 unsplit). Net sales of 8,800 other excluding wet blues were reported for China (5,600 pounds) and Mexico (3,200 pounds, including decreases of 400 pounds). Exports of 78,700 wet blues were down 57 percent from the previous week and 38 percent from the prior 4-week average. The destinations were primarily to Vietnam (30,200 unsplit), Italy (25,000 unsplit), China (8,200 unsplit), Hong Kong (7,900 unsplit), and Thailand (4,200 unsplit). No exports of other excluding wet blues were reported for the week. No net sales or exports of splits were reported for the week.

Beef: Net sales of 14,200 MT for 2026 were up 65 percent from the previous week and 42 percent from the prior 4-week average. Increases primarily for South Korea (6,100 MT, including decreases of 100 MT), Mexico (2,000 MT), Taiwan (1,400 MT, including decreases of 100 MT), Japan (1,300 MT, including decreases of 300 MT), and Hong Kong (1,300 MT, including decreases of 100 MT), were offset by reductions for Indonesia (100 MT). Exports of 9,900 MT were down 14 percent from the previous week and 18 percent from the prior 4-week average. The destinations were primarily to South Korea (3,300 MT), Japan (1,500 MT), Taiwan (1,400 MT), Mexico (1,300 MT), and Hong Kong (600 MT).

Pork: Net sales of 30,100 MT for 2026 were up 10 percent from the previous week, but down 6 percent from the prior 4-week average. Increases were primarily for Mexico (12,300 MT, including decreases of 600 MT), Japan (5,600 MT, including decreases of 200 MT), South Korea (4,000 MT, including decreases of 200 MT), China (2,500 MT, including decreases of 100 MT), and Canada (1,800 MT, including decreases of 200 MT). Total net sales of 300 MT for 2027 were for Japan. Exports of 27,600 MT were down 9 percent from the previous week and 6 percent from the prior 4-week average. The destinations were primarily to Mexico (13,400 MT), Japan (2,900 MT), China (2,700 MT), South Korea (2,200 MT), and Canada (2,000 MT).
